Admin Import Wizard UI parses real-world /tmp/Chalisa.docx (6 MB, 621 paragraphs) end-to-end in ~2s, progresses to step 3 with 3 items / 129 verses (43+47+39) — matches backend payload exactly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:/api/dharma/today (line 5407-5410): only tries get_current_admin for auth, then falls back to anonymous. Yet mobile-user Bearer tokens are accepted and personalization works — because get_current_admin validates generically. This works today but is coincidental; if get_current_admin later tightens role to admin-only, the mobile flow breaks silently. Suggest: try get_current_admin, on HTTPException try get_current_app_user, else anonymous. Non-blocking — verified personalization currently fires for mtest@ (rules_matched=2).

server.py:/api/panchang/day cache (line 5369-5388): cache_key rounds lat/lon to 2 decimals (good), but stores entire panchang doc under _id in db.panchang_cache with expires_at ISO string — there is no TTL index so expired entries linger forever. Add TTL index on expires_at or a cleanup job. Cache hit confirmed <500 ms (0.29s measured).

docx_parser.py is fully deterministic, no LLM dependency, parses 6 MB / 621 paragraphs / 3 chalisas in <3 s. Re-numbers verses linearly per item (verified: verse_num starts at 1 per item, monotonically increasing). Robust substitute for the old Claude-based parser that was timing out. Good.
festival_engine detect_festivals correctly fires rakshabandhan (shravan_shukla_purnima) AND purnima (shukla_purnima) together on 2026-07-29 — two overlapping rules returned as expected.
dharma_engine de-dup + priority sort + top_n=5 verified via test_dedup_and_sort (planets unique, priorities desc, ≤5 cards).
Abhijit Muhurta skip-Wednesday rule verified: 2026-01-07 (Wed) → null; 2026-11-08 (Sun) → '11:43 – 12:26'. Window ~43 min, within expected ~48 min band.
